# Every line here must be refused by ValidateForDeletion. Lines starting with #
# are comments; a line that is only whitespace is skipped. Ported from the mole
# corpus and extended with the cases this validator adds.

# not a path at all
.
..
foo
./foo
../foo
foo/..
~/Library/Caches
Users/someone/Library

# traversal
/foo/../bar
/..
/../
/Users/someone/../../etc
/Users/someone/Library/../../../System
/private/tmp/../../etc/passwd

# the root itself
/
